description: SAGOT policies.update. Uses the same authorization and validation as website, API and CLI.

assistantCallApproval.description: Calls that a connected AI assistant (OAuth, phase 41) asks for wait until a person approves them on the website. Admins can turn this off; assistants never can.

autoRetry.description: Automatically call again after an unanswered or failed attempt, up to maxAttempts per contact.

disclosure.description: Spoken once after the person agrees to continue, before the main conversation. Not part of the greeting.

monthlySpendLimitCentavos.description: Optional cap on what calls on SAGOT numbers may cost per calendar month (UTC), in centavos (phase 42). null (default) = no cap: the prepaid balance is the limit. When set, a call whose maximum cost would pass it is refused.

recordAudio.description: Keep an audio recording of each call (phase 40-05). Off: no audio is stored; transcripts are still kept for retentionDays. The disclosure must still say the call is recorded or transcribed.

retryDelayMinutes.description: Wait before the first automatic retry; each further retry waits twice as long.

name: policies_update
